meta.tagline: 1980 上美影式手绘赛璐璐，4:3 圆角片门，定稿 toon 人物 24 动作。

label: 上海美影手绘赛璐璐（老狼请客式）

canvas.logical: 4:3 片门 960×720 居中，左右留黑；人物设计空间 600×1000，地面 y=975

motion.dust: static paperize only, no per-frame specks
motion.camera: one different move per shot: push / pull / pan / follow / rise; no hand-held, no whip
motion.transitions: cut; veil or iris only to close
motion.vignette: radial rgba(4,14,13,.10) @0.55 → rgba(2,9,9,.62) edge + rgba(12,34,32,.07) teal wash

shots.cut_rule: cut only on a narration clause start / word onset (±0.35 s) or inside a silence gap >= 0.12 s
shots.note: applies to new projects from 2026-11-10; the frozen 玄奘 60 s sample predates this rule

sync.captions_source: timeline.lines[].words[] via EV.captionSegments(max 18); never divide by character count
sync.check: python scripts/laolang.py sync projects/<project> --html sample.html --video out/video-16x9.mp4 --ocr

audio.voice: reuse the user's 配音.wav: cut + 48 kHz stereo only, no re-record, no voice change; DP-align to a word-level timeline
audio.sfx_notes: 26 cue points in the 60 s sample; light effects drop out under the voice

render.engine: Chrome DevTools Protocol, frame by frame
render.fonts: local fallback; the stable page has no CDN font links

delivery.laolang_owns: move the film and create the delivery subdirectory only
files: 发布信息.txt (2 lines: title <=25 chars with digits + 4 tags)
delivery.source_dir: 源文件/ (cover prompts, meta, srt, credits, old cuts, reports)
delivery.project_config: delivery.json (cover_main 6 chars, cover_sub 8 chars, publish_title, tags, style, scene43, scene34)

frozen.rule: any change to proportions / hair / face / arm structure needs a new character sheet and user approval first

sample.name: 玄奘 · 60 秒样片（统一景别 · 稳定版）
